thread:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — onboarding request from DL Labs for their open LM. Need contract gating checklist: redistribution rights, marketplace SKU, KMS/HSM requirements, export controls, and joint announcement plan. Timeline: partner wants Public launch + SI bundle in ~6 weeks. Any blockers?
Leo (Legal): Thanks. Key legal points: need a redistribution addendum that specifies license (permissive vs. copyleft), attribution, and any export/geoblocking clauses. Ask DL Labs for provenance + dataset attestations. Also confirm whether weights are downloadable or hosted-only.
Sam (Eng): From infra POV: if they want downloadable quantized weights for SI bundles, we need a signed artifact process + integrity sigs. Recommend S3 artifact with signed URL + KMS-wrapped key. Also confirm model format (ggml/pt) and quantization level (4/8-bit).
Anya (Product): For joint announcement we need one shared PR draft, embargo window, and co-marketing assets. What's the desired message? Hosted API + SI on-prem offering? We should align on who owns the first social post.
Tom (SI Lead): SI checklist: install/test matrix for on-prem GPU (NVIDIA A100/40GB, Ampere), runtime compat (our serving runtime + quant path), and runbook for support handoff. Also need sample inference benchmark and resource estimate per q/s.
Maria (Partnerships): DL Labs replied: license = Apache-2 with model weights downloadable; they propose co-announce at launch. They indicated KMS requirement for enterprise downloads (customer-managed key) and want marketplace SKU. They can provide a provenance report.
Leo (Legal): Apache-2 + downloadable weights is fine but add a redistrib addendum limiting resale as a managed API under the provider's brand without attribution? (we should avoid overreach). Draft addendum: attribution line, no-sublicense-to-resell clause, export restrictions per US EAR. I'll draft and share.
Sam (Eng): Two engineering items: (1) KMS integration: need ability to encrypt artifacts with customer KMS at rest — confirm which KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure). (2) If downloadable, we need host-bundle packaging + checksums. I can spin up a mini test with a 7B quant model next week.
Anya (Product): Timeline check: legal draft by EOD Thu? engineering review by next Tue? marketing asset draft by next Fri? Partner prefers launch week of May 12th.
Tom (SI Lead): Agree. We'll prepare SI installer and test plan by May 5th.
Maria (Partnerships): Ok — action items:
- Leo: share redistrib addendum draft (by Thu EOD)
- Sam: KMS & packaging doc + test note (by Tue)
- Anya: joint PR outline + asset list (by Fri)
- Tom: SI install/test matrix (by May 5)
DL contact: rachel@dllabs.ai
Can everyone react with :eyes: when you grab an item so I can track.
Leo (Legal): :eyes:
Sam (Eng): Grabbing KMS + packaging, will post a short checklist. :thumbsup:
Anya (Product): I'll start the PR outline and Slack copy. :eyes:
Tom (SI Lead): On it — will schedule a pre-test call with DL next Wed.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled — follow-up thread in 3 days.
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks team — keeping this thread for updates. If anything changes ping me directly.
